title: AI handoff: second handoff's auto-send doesn't fire into an existing (hydrating) build conversation
body:
Residual from #2449 (ADR-0057 P4 follow-ups). **Not a regression** — before #2449 a second handoff did nothing at all; now the context re-carries but the new prompt still needs one manual send.

## Symptom (observed live, local rig)
1. Ask agent declines request A → "Open in Builder →" → build conversation minted, prompt A auto-sends, blueprint proposed (**Awaiting Approval**). ✅ (fixed by #2449)
2. Back on the ask thread, decline for a different request B → click the second "Open in Builder →".
3. The route lands on the **existing** build conversation (singleton per user/app/product), `?handoffPrompt=B&parentConversationId=…` present — but **no `POST …/chat` fires**. The composer stays empty; the surface still shows blueprint A awaiting approval.
4. A **manual** send in the build composer works and **does** carry the re-armed `context.parentConversationId` (verified on the wire) — so the #2449 re-carry is functioning; only the auto-send is lost.

## Suspected mechanism
For an existing conversation, `conversationId` is already present at `ChatPane` mount, so `useDeferredFirstSend`'s replay fires immediately — likely before `useObjectChat`/`useChat` finishes hydrating `initialMessages` (and/or while the pane is mid-remount on the ask→build route switch). The send is issued into a hook instance that's about to be torn down or not yet ready, and is dropped. The fresh-conversation path has a natural "pending id" phase that orders things correctly, which is why #2449's fix works there.

Files: `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (`useDeferredFirstSend`, the ADR-0057 P4 handoff seed effect, `pendingFirstMessageSeq`), `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useObjectChat.ts`.

## Suggested direction
Gate the deferred replay on hydration-ready for the resume case — e.g. replay only once the pane's `useObjectChat` reports messages hydrated (or defer via a `requestAnimationFrame`/effect tick after `initialMessages` are applied). Add a live-rig proof: second handoff → `POST …/chat` fires automatically with `context.parentConversationId` and prompt B.

## Product question (separate but adjacent)
When the second handoff lands on a conversation whose blueprint is still **Awaiting Approval**, what should happen to the pending blueprint? Today it just sits there; the new request arrives with no UI acknowledgment of the pending plan. Worth a small UX decision (banner "你有一个待确认的方案" / queue / supersede).

Refs: #2449, #2444, #2439, cloud#819/#820, ADR-0057 §P4.
